state.paragraph: unintended public disclosure. Accordingly, the Company set the evening of Wednesday, December 10 (five days, rather than 10 days prior to the anticipated December 15 completion date) as the deadline for submission of final bids, and at the same time asked the bidders to submit mark-ups of the draft merger agreement and the other transaction documents and financing commitments, if possible, in advance.

ledger_rows.Note: Six of the potentially interested parties submitted indications of interest.
Preliminary non-binding indication; range $81.00–$83.00; consideration not stated.
Another of the six submitters; non-binding range $80.00–$85.00; not individually named.
Remainder of the six submitters; no individual detail or prices; one later advanced, two eliminated 11/03 (#24).
Raised after J.P. Morgan's 10/30–11/02 calls; range $81.00–$84.00; made it one of four at or above $80.00.
Final round opened by the 11/03 advancement of four bidders at or above $80.00; merger-agreement form circulated in November; updated FY2014 projections given to all finalists.
6 submitters − 4 advanced = 2 notified as eliminated; none could remain above their initial indications.
Set evening 12/10 for final bids, replacing the initial 12/05 plan; mark-ups and financing commitments requested in advance.
Final bids due; Buyer Group and Bidder 2 submitted; Bidder 3 no written offer.
Final bid letter with revised merger agreement; financing commitment documents provided 12/06; committee required improvement (#31).
Final bid letter with revised merger agreement; financing commitments not stated at this stage.
No written offer: verbal valuation not above ~$78 stock price; J.P. Morgan said unlikely to be competitive.
After 12/10 bids, required improvements by 12/12; J.P. Morgan informed bidders and contacted Longview 12/11.

deadline.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
